info.shortName: iShares US Small Cap Value Fact
info.longName: iShares US Small Cap Value Factor ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the Russell 2000 Focused Value Select Index (the “underlying index”), which is an equal-weighted equity index provided by FTSE Russell (the “index provider” or “Russell”). The underlying index measures the performance of small-capitalization U.S. companies with prominent value factor characteristics, as determined by the index Provider.
